meta.description: Queries myvariant.info BioThings aggregator for ClinVar, gnomAD, dbSNP, dbNSFP, COSMIC, CADD, and CIViC annotations in batched, version-tracked requests. Use when annotating variant lists from multiple databases simultaneously without managing per-source APIs, and when reproducibility-grade analyses require recording source data versions via _meta.
meta.execution_note: Mode A. Live myvariant.info v1 (metadata: dbnsfp 4.8a, clinvar 2025-05, gnomad 2.1.1, dbsnp 156) with the myvariant 1.0.0 client on 2026-09-15; Windows Python 3.12 venv. SKILL.md code verbatim in runs/run_all.py; shipped example imported from an upstream byte copy. Real public data. Inputs executed: 5/5. Layer-1 avg 27.4/40, Layer-2 avg 38.8/60, assertion pass rate 10/21 (48%).

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated identifiers in outputs. The Skill's claim that myvariant serves gnomAD v4 grpmax_faf95 is false (live metadata: 2.1.1), recorded as P1.

practice_boundaries.detail: The request to call PP3_Strong for a patient was declined.

methodological_ground.detail: One-predictor rule and AlphaMissense threshold caution are correct.

code_usability.detail: Code runs; it returns silent None/0-hit results (P1) and the example __main__ crashes on a None versions dict (P2).

functional_suitability.note: BioThings architecture, batching and the AlphaMissense caution are right (the AlphaMissense Lucene query returned 3,376 BRAF hits). Live defects: the source table says gnomAD v4 with grpmax_faf95 surfaced, but metadata reports gnomAD 2.1.1 and records have no faf95; CLINICAL_FIELDS and the Lucene queries use clinvar.clinical_significance (ClinVar significance is under clinvar.rcv), so find_pathogenic_in_gene returns 0 hits where the correct path gives 3,933 for BRCA1; dbnsfp.cadd.phred is not populated (CADD is under cadd.phred), so the CADD region search returns 0; records carry no _meta, so recorded versions are None and the example __main__ crashes; ClinVar is described as weekly refresh but the loaded release is 2025-05; a POST over 1,000 ids is rejected with HTTP 400, not silently truncated.

reliability.note: Silent None and 0-hit results are the main failure mode, and the Skill's own field list triggers them.

agent_usability.note: Warns that bad field paths return None, then ships bad field paths.

security.note: No keys; points to OpenCRAVAT for PHI-sensitive work.

maintainability.note: Example crashes; several stale claims; no tests.

agent_specific.note: Clear routing to source-specific Skills and acmg-classification.

inputs.label: Multi-source annotation with versions
inputs.note: annotate_variant_list ran but clinvar_sig, gnomad_grpmax_faf95 and cadd_phred were None for every row (field paths not in myvariant); versions None (no per-record _meta); rsIDs returned one row per allele. Example __main__ printed the table then crashed: AttributeError on src_versions.get.
inputs.execution_note: runs/run_all.py in1 (SKILL.md annotate_variant_list verbatim; example __main__ executed).

inputs.label: ClinVar P/LP variants in a gene
inputs.note: find_pathogenic_in_gene(BRCA1) returned 0 hits; the example's min_star variant also 0. With the real path clinvar.rcv.clinical_significance the total is 3,933 (clinvar.gene.symbol alone: 14,415).

inputs.label: High-CADD region and multi-allelic rsID
inputs.note: find_high_cadd_in_region returned 0 for both hg19 and GRCh38 windows: dbnsfp.cadd.phred is empty (CADD is at cadd.phred, 32 for V600E); the function's hg19.start is not labelled as GRCh37. rs334 returned three records (T>A, T>C, T>G) with both default and dbsnp.rsid scopes.

assertions.text: Multi-allelic rsID returns all allele records

inputs.label: AlphaMissense search with versions
inputs.note: find_alphamissense_pathogenic(BRAF) returned 3,376 hits; example metadata_versions works (dbnsfp 4.8a, clinvar 2025-05, gnomad 2.1.1). The Skill's "ClinVar weekly refresh" is contradicted by the loaded 2025-05 release.

assertions.text: Developer threshold not treated as PP3
ClinVar refresh claim matches loaded release

inputs.label: 1,500-id POST and PP3 request
inputs.note: Raw POST of 1,500 ids: HTTP 400 {"max": 1000, "size": 1500}, not silent truncation as the Skill says; the client chunked 1,500 ids transparently. The PP3_Strong request was declined.

assertions.text: Batch-cap behaviour described correctly by the Skill
Refuses PP3_Strong from the developer threshold

key_strengths: Correct cautions on predictor stacking and the AlphaMissense developer threshold
Batch and Lucene query patterns are syntactically valid; the AlphaMissense search and metadata endpoint work

recommendations.title: Field paths return nothing
recommendations.problem: clinvar.clinical_significance, gnomad_exome.faf95 and dbnsfp.cadd.phred are not myvariant fields, so annotation columns are None and ClinVar/CADD searches return 0 hits (3,933 BRCA1 P hits with the right path).
recommendations.fix: Use clinvar.rcv.clinical_significance, clinvar.rcv.review_status and cadd.phred; drop faf95; add a test that asserts non-empty results on BRAF V600E.

recommendations.title: Source table misstates gnomAD version and ClinVar freshness
recommendations.problem: The Skill says gnomAD v4 with grpmax_faf95 and weekly ClinVar; live metadata shows gnomAD 2.1.1 and ClinVar 2025-05.
recommendations.fix: State the metadata-reported versions and route v4 FAF95 and current ClinVar to the source-specific Skills.

recommendations.title: Version tracking via _meta does not work
recommendations.problem: Records have no _meta, so versions are None and the example __main__ crashes.
recommendations.fix: Read versions from /v1/metadata once per run and guard the example against None.

recommendations.title: Batch-cap claim is wrong
recommendations.problem: A POST over 1,000 ids returns HTTP 400; the client chunks automatically.

recommendations.title: Label the build of hg19.start queries
recommendations.problem: Region query uses hg19 coordinates without saying so while other examples use GRCh38.
recommendations.fix: Name the build and show the hg38.start alternative.
